title: Is BaZi Accurate? What Science and 3,000 Years of Data Say
titleZh: 八字是真的嗎？懷疑論者的實話指南
description: Does Chinese astrology actually work? We break down what BaZi can reliably predict — career timing, relationship patterns, life cycle shifts — and what it can't, based on how practitioners actually use it.
descriptionZh: 八字是迷信還是有統計基礎？本文誠實分析四柱命理能可靠預測什麼（事業時機、感情週期、人生階段轉換），不能預測什麼，以及如何辨別真正有水平的命理師。用數據說話，看完這篇你自己判斷。

title: How to Read Your BaZi Chart: A Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners
titleZh: 如何解讀你的八字命盤：新手逐步指南
description: What is BaZi? Learn the Four Pillars of Destiny for free — Day Master, Five Elements, Ten Gods, and how your birth time shapes your personality and career path.
descriptionZh: 八字是什麼？用出生年月日時排出的四柱命盤，揭示你的性格、事業、財運和感情模式。這份免費新手指南用簡單語言和實例，5 分鐘帶你入門中國最古老的命理系統。只需 5 分鐘，了解這套延續三千年的智慧系統。

title: BaZi Ten Gods: What Your Chart Says About Friendships
titleZh: 八字十神：你的命盤如何揭示友誼模式 | Dao Essentia
description: Your BaZi chart's Ten Gods reveal your friendship patterns in Chinese astrology — why certain people drain you while others energize you. Discover your friendship archetype and improve your social circle today.
descriptionZh: 八字十神揭示你的交友模式——食傷吸引創意圈、印星結交長輩貴人、比劫帶來競爭夥伴。了解你的命盤如何決定社交圈品質，以及哪些人會消耗你的能量、哪些人能助你成長。查詢你的命盤十神配置，了解你的最佳社交策略。

title: Stop Paying $200 — Learn to Read BaZi

description: Most BaZi readings cost $100-300 and leave you with more questions than answers. You can learn to read your own birth chart for free in about two weeks of casual study.

description: The 10 BaZi Day Masters explained as modern characters you'd recognize from your own life. From Jia Wood CEOs to Gui Water mystics — find your archetype.
